contract.rootPrecondition: B-validated v7 root; runtime guard checks non-null non-array root object, schemaVersion 7, non-null non-array projects object. Other invalid roots are outside public error contract.
contract.errorType: Synchronous Error instance named ProjectStateError with code and message equal to error code; no additional fields beyond A error contract.

priority.create: ROOT_INVALID, PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_NAME_DUPLICATE in projectOrder, PROJECT_ID_EXHAUSTED, then A wrap INVALID_ARGUMENT/INVALID_JSON/WORKSPACE_VERSION/WORKSPACE_INVALID
priority.rename: ROOT_INVALID, INVALID_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_NAME_DUPLICATE excluding own project, then same-original-name identity noop or name replacement
priority.setEnabled: ROOT_INVALID, INVALID_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, PROJECT_ENABLED, same-value identity noop, then LAST_ENABLED_PROJECT on false if no other enabled project
priority.delete: ROOT_INVALID, INVALID_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, LAST_ENABLED_PROJECT when no other enabled project

contract.selection: Disable/delete active target chooses first other enabled project in projectOrder. Non-active target changes preserve activeProjectId. Enabling preserves activeProjectId. Creation selects new project.
contract.immutability: No input mutations. Create copies root/projects/order and creates new project/workspace, preserving old project references. Rename/setEnabled copy root/projects/target only and preserve order/props/workspace/other projects. Delete copies root/projects/order and preserves survivors. Rename identical original name and setEnabled identical boolean return original root.
contract.creation: New ID p+projectSeq; increase projectSeq by 1; append ID. enabled true; connectionRef default; dataEnabled true; automationEnabled false. Callback receives only one deep cloned workspace argument per A, strict true required; throw/false/Promise fail WORKSPACE_INVALID. Clone mutation cannot change output workspace. Counter at MAX_SAFE_INTEGER errors before callback.
contract.names: Trim equality, 1..32 Unicode code points, uniqueness by NFKC then locale-independent lowercase. Store original name unchanged.

resolvedFindings.reason: Re-read current C scope: PCC3 explicitly sets E.projectSeq to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and passes valid name/text/callback, so PROJECT_ID_EXHAUSTED with callbackCalls 0 follows D7.

PCC14 now explicitly passes deleteProject's returned root and JSON.stringify(W) to createProject. Sequence remains 3 after deleting p2, then new p3 increases it to 4 and becomes active. No remaining blocking mismatch found.
